shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.scope: Workspace commands pause while a modal is open. Close dismisses the front modal; Quit uses the normal quit flow.
shortcuts.modifiers: Both Cmd and Ctrl work. On macOS, use Cmd while editing text. Shortcuts pause during text composition.
shortcuts.toolbar: Image actions: Tab enters or leaves; Left/Right moves focus; Home/End moves to either end. Enter/Space activates. Zoom and comparison controls keep their native keys.
shortcuts.collections: Sessions and results: arrows move focus; Enter selects. In results, Space toggles and Shift extends selection. Home/End moves to either end; PageUp/PageDown moves five items.
shortcuts.splitter: Request divider: Left/Right adjusts the width; Home resets it.
shortcuts.native: Standard text editing and window shortcuts follow the native menus.
